lieu: boss's office in the Plateau business district of Abidjan, big wooden desk, leather chair, window with skyscrapers

persos.nom: the employee in the blue shirt
persos.desc: confident employee in his 30s, light-blue shirt, tie, folder under his arm
persos.pose: standing in front of the desk, chest out, confident

persos.nom: the boss in the grey suit
persos.desc: boss in his 50s, grey suit, big belly, reading glasses
persos.pose: leaning back in his leather chair, skeptical

dialogue: Patron, augmentez-moi. Trois entreprises me cherchent !
Lesquelles ?
La CIE, la SODECI et mon propriétaire.
Assieds-toi. Ils me cherchent aussi.
jeu: The employee speaks proudly. The boss raises an eyebrow. The employee lists them on his fingers. The boss sighs and points at the chair.
chute: The boss pulls his own thick pile of unpaid bills out of the drawer and drops it on the desk. End on a close-up of the employee's shocked face looking into the camera.

lieu: open-plan office in Abidjan, desks with computers, a man asleep on his keyboard, the boss standing behind him

persos.desc: boss in his 50s, blue suit, mug of coffee, angry eyebrows
employee in his 30s, white shirt, tie loose, keyboard marks on his cheek, drool

dialogue: Tu dors au travail ?!
Non patron… je réfléchissais les yeux fermés pour l'entreprise.
jeu: The boss shouts. The employee jumps awake and answers very seriously, pretending to think.

lieu: street mechanic garage in Abobo, Abidjan, old car with the hood open, tools on the ground, oil stains

persos.desc: mechanic in his 40s, oil-stained blue overalls, wrench in hand
car owner in his 50s, white shirt, briefcase, worried face

dialogue: Il faut changer le moteur, les freins et les pneus.
Donc tu gardes seulement le klaxon ?
jeu: The mechanic lists the problems. The owner presses the horn sadly and it makes a tiny squeak.

lieu: street barbershop in Koumassi, Abidjan, plastic chair, mirror, hair clippings on the floor

persos.desc: completely bald man in his 50s, shiny head, striped barber cape
young barber in his 20s, red cap, comb and clippers in hands
persos.pose: looking at the bald head, confused

dialogue: Fais-moi le dégradé !
Tonton, il n'y a plus rien à dégrader.
jeu: The bald client asks proudly. The barber looks at the shiny head, searches for hair with the comb, then answers.

lieu: hospital consultation room in Abidjan, white walls, examination bed, medical cabinet

persos.desc: nurse in her 30s, white uniform, nurse cap, holding a big syringe
huge muscular man in his 30s, tank top, tattoos, trembling like a child

dialogue: N'aie pas peur, ça ne fait pas mal.
Alors pique-toi d'abord. Moi je regarde.
jeu: The nurse approaches gently. The huge man hides behind a tiny chair and points at her arm.

lieu: doctor's office in Treichville, Abidjan, old medical posters, wooden desk

persos.desc: young doctor in his 30s, white coat, stethoscope, serious face
persos.pose: listing forbidden things on his fingers

persos.nom: the old man with the walking stick
persos.desc: old man in his 70s, white kaftan, kufi hat, walking stick

dialogue: Pour vivre longtemps : plus de sucre, plus de sel, plus de bière.
Docteur, vivre longtemps pour faire quoi alors ?
jeu: The doctor lists the rules. The old man stands up, outraged, and asks the question seriously.

lieu: front door of a small house in Abobo, Abidjan, electricity meter on the wall, an agent with a bill

persos.desc: electricity company agent in his 30s, orange work vest, cap, holding a long bill
man in his 40s, white singlet, pagne around his waist, holding a tiny bulb

dialogue: Votre facture : quatre-vingt-cinq mille francs.
Vous allumez le soleil chez moi ou quoi ?
jeu: The agent unrolls a very long bill. The man shows his only tiny bulb and protests.

lieu: tontine meeting in a courtyard in Koumassi, Abidjan, women sitting in a circle on plastic chairs, a cash box in the middle

persos.nom: the tontine president with the cash box
persos.desc: tontine president in her 50s, purple boubou, glasses, notebook

persos.nom: the woman in the yellow headwrap
persos.desc: woman in her 30s, yellow headwrap, big earrings, chewing gum
two other women in colorful wax dresses

dialogue: Ma sœur, c'est ton tour de cotiser !
Moi, je suis dans la tontine pour recevoir seulement.
jeu: The president reminds her. The woman answers calmly, chewing her gum, and the other members gasp.

lieu: small neighborhood shop in Yopougon, Abidjan, shelves of rice, oil, sugar, a thick credit notebook on the counter

persos.desc: shopkeeper in his 40s, white skullcap, holding a huge thick credit notebook
persos.pose: slamming the notebook on the counter

persos.nom: the customer with the bag of rice
persos.desc: customer in his 30s, red jersey, carrying a bag of rice on his shoulder

dialogue: Tu me dois déjà vingt mille !
Note encore. Ton cahier est épais.
jeu: The shopkeeper slams the notebook. The customer taps the thick notebook encouragingly and walks away with the rice.

lieu: phone stalls in Adjame market, Abidjan, glass display with smartphones, colorful phone cases hanging

persos.desc: young woman in her 20s, braids, jean jacket, holding a phone
smooth seller in his 20s, gold chain, sunglasses, three phones in each hand

dialogue: Ton téléphone-là, c'est un original ?
Original ! Original d'Adjamé !
jeu: The customer examines the phone. The seller answers proudly and the phone's back cover falls off.

lieu: moto-taxi on a road in Abobo, Abidjan, fast motion, dust, passenger holding on tight

persos.desc: passenger in her 40s, office dress, headwrap flying in the wind, holding on tight
moto-taxi driver in his 20s, orange vest, helmet with goggles, eyes closed
persos.pose: driving with his eyes closed, relaxed smile

dialogue: Doucement ! Tu roules trop vite !
Ferme les yeux comme moi, tu n'auras plus peur.
jeu: The passenger screams. The driver answers calmly with his eyes closed. The passenger opens her eyes wide.

lieu: inside a crowded gbaka minibus in Adjame, Abidjan, the apprentice collecting fares

persos.desc: bus apprentice in his 20s, yellow t-shirt, coins in hand
cheeky grandmother in her 70s, green headwrap, cane, small coin purse
persos.pose: handing over only half the coins

dialogue: Je suis vieille. Je paie moitié prix.
Alors on te dépose à moitié chemin, Mamie.
jeu: The grandmother hands over half the fare proudly. The apprentice counts the coins and answers with a smirk.

lieu: shared courtyard in Abobo, Abidjan, outdoor kitchen, pots and charcoal stove

persos.desc: neighbor in her 30s, pink wax dress, flip-flops, empty basket on her arm
woman in her 40s, blue headwrap, apron, hands on hips

dialogue: Ma sœur, prête-moi ta marmite, ton riz et ton huile.
Et tu vas cuisiner où ?
Chez toi. Mon gaz est fini.
jeu: The neighbor asks sweetly. The woman frowns. The neighbor sits down in her kitchen, very comfortable.

lieu: evening in Yopougon, Abidjan, a man watching TV in his living room, his neighbor watching through the window from outside

persos.desc: man in his 40s, blue boubou, remote control in hand, angry
persos.pose: turning around to the window, angry

persos.desc: neighbor in his 30s, white t-shirt, leaning on the windowsill, eating popcorn

dialogue: Ça fait trois ans que tu regardes ma télé !
Change de chaîne. Ce film-là, je l'ai déjà vu.
jeu: The owner shouts at the window. The neighbor keeps eating popcorn and complains about the program.

lieu: early morning in a courtyard in Abobo, Abidjan, a rooster crowing on a wall, sunrise

persos.desc: neighbor in his 30s, striped pyjamas, eyes red with sleep, pillow in hand
rooster owner in his 60s, kaftan, holding a cup of coffee

dialogue: Ton coq me réveille chaque matin !
Normal. C'est le seul du quartier qui a un travail.
jeu: The neighbor complains. The owner pets his rooster proudly and answers.

lieu: night in Koumassi, Abidjan, power cut everywhere, one house lit up with a noisy generator in the yard

persos.desc: neighbor in her 40s, nightgown, headscarf, covering her ears
proud man in his 50s, shiny tracksuit, sitting next to a smoking generator
persos.pose: sitting next to the generator, proud

dialogue: Ton groupe électrogène fait trop de bruit !
Ma sœur, c'est le bruit de la richesse.
jeu: The neighbor shouts over the noise. The man pats the generator proudly like a pet.

lieu: living room in Cocody, Abidjan, table with empty plates and glasses, a guest on the sofa

persos.nom: the host with the empty plates
persos.desc: host in his 30s, white shirt, collecting empty plates
guest in his 30s, red cap, lying on the sofa, holding his phone
persos.pose: lying on the sofa, very comfortable

dialogue: C'est quoi le code du wifi ?
Tu as mangé ici, tu as bu ici… et tu veux aussi le wifi ?
jeu: The guest asks casually. The host lists everything on his fingers, increasingly irritated.

lieu: shared courtyard in Treichville, Abidjan, laundry line with pagnes drying in the sun

persos.nom: the woman looking for her pagne
persos.desc: woman in her 30s, simple white t-shirt, pointing at the empty laundry line
persos.pose: pointing at the empty line, angry

persos.desc: neighbor in her 30s, wearing a bright orange-and-blue pagne, posing like a model

dialogue: Qui a pris mon pagne sur la corde ?!
Ma sœur, ton pagne-là, il me cherchait.
jeu: The woman shouts. The neighbor turns around like a model, showing off the stolen pagne.

lieu: sunny street in Abobo, Abidjan, two neighbor women chatting at a public water tap, a cheerful man dancing in the background

persos.nom: the woman in the red headwrap
persos.desc: woman in her 50s, red headwrap, yellow wax dress, plastic bucket at her feet

persos.nom: the woman with the hand fan
persos.desc: woman in her 50s, green boubou, holding a hand fan
persos.pose: hand on her heart, sad face

persos.desc: happy man in his 40s, colorful open shirt over a white t-shirt, cheerful face
persos.pose: dancing joyfully in the background with his arms in the air

dialogue: Tu as appris ? La femme de Kouamé est partie !
Le pauvre… Il doit beaucoup souffrir…
jeu: The gossips whisper sadly, then both turn their heads and see the happy man dancing with joy in the background.

lieu: terrace of a maquis in Marcory, Abidjan, two friends at a table, phone showing a heavily filtered profile photo

persos.desc: young woman in her 20s, short hair, green t-shirt, holding a phone
persos.pose: looking at the phone, then at her friend

persos.desc: young woman in her 20s, lots of makeup, big wig, posing

dialogue: Ma chérie, ta photo de profil est trop belle !
Merci !
C'est qui sur la photo ?
jeu: The friend compliments her. The proud friend thanks her, then the friend compares the photo with her face, confused.

lieu: lagoon promenade in Abidjan at sunset, Plateau skyline in the background

persos.desc: young woman in her 20s, yellow dress, big hat, posing for a photo
young man in his 20s, blue shirt, holding a phone to take a photo, walking around her
persos.pose: walking around her with the phone, searching

dialogue: Bébé, prends mon meilleur côté !
Je cherche encore.
jeu: The girl poses dramatically. The boyfriend keeps walking around her with the phone, searching from every angle.

lieu: family courtyard in Bingerville near Abidjan, uncle showing photos on his phone to the family

persos.desc: uncle in his 50s, leather jacket in the heat, sunglasses, Paris scarf
nephew around 15, zooming on the uncle's phone, smirking

dialogue: À Paris, je mangeais au restaurant chaque jour !
Tonton, la photo montre que tu faisais la plonge.
jeu: The uncle brags. The nephew zooms on the photo showing the uncle washing dishes, and shows it to everyone.

lieu: arrivals hall of the Abidjan airport, families waiting, a young man with sunglasses and a big coat

persos.desc: young man in his 20s, big winter coat, scarf, sunglasses, suitcase
aunt in her 50s, orange boubou, arms crossed

dialogue: Il fait trop chaud ici, je ne suis plus habitué.
Tu es parti il y a deux semaines !
jeu: The nephew complains dramatically. The aunt crosses her arms and answers, unimpressed.

lieu: busy sidewalk in the Plateau district of Abidjan, people walking fast, a cousin from the village looking around

persos.desc: cousin in his 20s, traditional tunic, bag on his head, amazed eyes
city cousin in his 20s, sunglasses, sneakers, walking fast

dialogue: Cousin, pourquoi les gens marchent vite à Abidjan ?
Ils fuient ceux qui demandent l'argent. Comme toi.
jeu: The village cousin asks, amazed. The city cousin answers while walking even faster.

lieu: veranda of a village-style house in Anyama near Abidjan, rocking chair, sunset

persos.desc: grandson around 12, holding a tablet, curious
grandfather in his 80s, white kaftan, sitting in a rocking chair, eyes closed, peaceful smile

dialogue: Papi, tu as connu la vie sans téléphone ?
Oui. On l'appelait : la paix.
jeu: The grandson asks. The grandfather keeps rocking with his eyes closed and answers with a peaceful smile.
